Youth Volleyball

The YMCA Youth Volleyball program helps young athletes develop volleyball fundamentals while building confidence, teamwork, and sportsmanship in a fun and encouraging environment. Players of all skill levels and abilities are welcome, whether they’re learning the basics or continuing to develop their game.

The Youth Volleyball season is held during the fall months.
Youth Volleyball camp is during the summer.
All practices and games are held at Bluestone High School in Skipwith, VA.

Volunteer Coaches Needed! Volunteer coaches play an important role in helping young athletes learn new skills and develop confidence. The YMCA provides support and resources for every coach. Apply to volunteer here.

Age group eligibility is determined by age as of 9/30/2026 for the 2026 – 2027 program year. This is so kids will play with others in the same grade level as themselves.
Playing UP in age level is an option but you will need to first register in the appropriate age group and then speak to the Program Director, Jenna Boswell. Her email is [email protected].

6U - Ages 5 & 6

All Locations
10/19/26 - 12/12/26
VIEW

First Touches. Big Smiles. Lots of Fun!

Players will learn:

  • How to catch, toss, and hit a volleyball
  • Basic passing and serving skills
  • Balance, coordination, and body control
  • Listening, sharing, and taking turns
  • Teamwork and sportsmanship

There are no standings or championships—our goal is for every child to have fun, build confidence, and develop a love for being active.

Program Information

  • One 60 minute practice each week
  • Games on Saturdays
  • All equipment is age-appropriate
  • No experience necessary
  • Schedules determined when registration closes
